# WonderElian

> WonderElian is the personal creative world of Elian Yong, a designer and independent maker in Wuhan, China. It brings together digital products, design work, and reflective field notes about artificial intelligence, visual culture, self-understanding, and life.

Canonical site: https://wonderelian.com/
Author and creator: Elian Yong
Languages: Chinese at /zh/ and English at /en/; every published field note has a stable URL in each language.
Guiding idea: Designing things. Exploring life. Know yourself within; move through the world like water.
Creative approach: Elian combines design judgment, product thinking, and AI to turn complex ideas into clear, beautiful products people can use. His work spans industrial brand communication, digital reading, meditation, and visual culture, with attention to both business outcomes and human experience.

## Primary products

- [Yixiu Meditation](https://yixiu.wonderelian.com/): Meditation, breathing, sound, and quiet for settling the body and emotions before moving forward.
- [Buer Within](https://buer.wonderelian.com/): An AI growth companion for everyday conversations, self-reflection, and a personal growth profile that helps turn insights into action.
- [Wendao](https://wendao.wonderelian.com/): A slower, carefully designed reading of the Tao Te Ching with source text, notes, translation, interpretation, and daily practice.
- [Xiazi Global News Posters](https://xiazishuo.com/): Global events translated into a bilingual visual-poster format.
- [Style Atlas](https://style-atlas.wonderelian.com/): A visual guide to art movements, design styles, and the language behind images.
- [OneLaser](https://onelaser.wonderelian.com/): Brand and product-expression work for laser technology.
- [Maker Business Lab](https://maker.wonderelian.com/): Transparent product, profit, capacity, and equipment planning for maker businesses. It begins with the business rather than the machine.

## Field notes

- [A Friend Told Me to Make More Visually Polished Videos. But First, I Want to...](https://wonderelian.com/en/notes/make-what-delights-you-first/) · [中文版](https://wonderelian.com/zh/notes/make-what-delights-you-first/): Being good at something—and knowing it has value—does not mean it deserves most of your energy right now. Begin with what you still want to use and improve tomorrow.
- [I Built a Few Products with AI—and Slowly Pieced Together the Life I Want](https://wonderelian.com/en/notes/building-the-life-i-want-with-ai/) · [中文版](https://wonderelian.com/zh/notes/building-the-life-i-want-with-ai/): From 81 everyday-life comics to a daily rhythm of seeing the world, reading a chapter, and resting at noon: the products I made are becoming a way of living.
- [You Love It. Will Anyone Pay for It? The Hardest Step in Building a Product](https://wonderelian.com/en/notes/will-others-pay-for-what-you-love/) · [中文版](https://wonderelian.com/zh/notes/will-others-pay-for-what-you-love/): Your own need can start a product. Reaching a market takes a concrete problem, clear value, a small real transaction, and a business you can keep running.
- [People Are Paying for My App. Not Much Money, but I’m Happy.](https://wonderelian.com/en/notes/wendao-first-payments/) · [中文版](https://wonderelian.com/zh/notes/wendao-first-payments/): Two transactions and CNY 11.41 in estimated revenue. A small beginning worth celebrating—and a reason to keep improving something I use myself.
- [OpenAI Dots Is Here: As AI Gets More Capable, Can I Worry Less?](https://wonderelian.com/en/notes/openai-dots-less-to-worry-about/) · [中文版](https://wonderelian.com/zh/notes/openai-dots-less-to-worry-about/): What creates relief is not simply AI doing more, but an agent that can carry work forward, respect boundaries, and truly take one recurring responsibility off your mind.
- [When an Agent Has a Phone Number and a Wallet, It Is No Longer Just a Chat Box: Manus Cue Enters the Physical World](https://wonderelian.com/en/notes/manus-cue-agent-identity/) · [中文版](https://wonderelian.com/zh/notes/manus-cue-agent-identity/): For AI to enter the physical world, it needs more than a smarter model: a phone, email, wallet, computer, and clear boundaries for permission and responsibility.
- [When AI Can Code, Design, and Run Operations, What Is Left for Ordinary Internet Professionals?](https://wonderelian.com/en/notes/human-value-after-ai/) · [中文版](https://wonderelian.com/zh/notes/human-value-after-ai/): AI is narrowing the gap in execution while widening the gap in judgment. Value now lies in finding problems, making choices, understanding people, and owning outcomes.
- [AI Employees Have Started Work: A One-Person Company Can Finally Have a Digital Team](https://wonderelian.com/en/notes/ai-employees-digital-team/) · [中文版](https://wonderelian.com/zh/notes/ai-employees-digital-team/): A one-person company expands through the range of work one person can direct. AI executes; the creator keeps direction, taste, empathy, and responsibility.
- [The Best Ad May No Longer Be an Image, but a Salesperson You Can Talk To](https://wonderelian.com/en/notes/conversational-ads/) · [中文版](https://wonderelian.com/zh/notes/conversational-ads/): When an ad can understand space, budget, preferences, and doubts, the opportunity is to turn product knowledge into an honest conversation.
- [The New Siri Is Here: AI Will Not Kill Apps, but It Will Eliminate One Kind of App](https://wonderelian.com/en/notes/siri-ai-callable-apps/) · [中文版](https://wonderelian.com/zh/notes/siri-ai-callable-apps/): People may stop opening your app while continuing to use its value. Siri is turning apps from destinations into capabilities AI can understand and call.
- [At 40, I No Longer Rush to Prove Myself: A Designer Built Seven Products with AI—and Learned How to Live Again](https://wonderelian.com/en/notes/from-proving-to-becoming/) · [中文版](https://wonderelian.com/zh/notes/from-proving-to-becoming/): From big-tech design, serial entrepreneurship, and a long personal low to returning to design, AI, and independent creation.
- [100 Issues, 1,800 Posters: Looking at the World Every Day, What Is Quietly Changing Our Future?](https://wonderelian.com/en/notes/xiazi-100-issues-1800-posters/) · [中文版](https://wonderelian.com/zh/notes/xiazi-100-issues-1800-posters/): Daily curiosity becomes a body of work through choosing stories, writing in two languages, and making fresh visual judgments.
- [After More Than $4 Million in Annual Profit, He Says: I Do Not Want a Bigger One-Person Business](https://wonderelian.com/en/notes/justin-welsh-small-by-design/) · [中文版](https://wonderelian.com/zh/notes/justin-welsh-small-by-design/): Justin Welsh’s choices raise a different question: if an opportunity succeeds, will it give me the life I want?
- [Apple Now Lets Multiple Apps Share One Subscription. Is This a New Opportunity for One-Person Companies?](https://wonderelian.com/en/notes/apple-shared-subscriptions-one-person-company/) · [中文版](https://wonderelian.com/zh/notes/apple-shared-subscriptions-one-person-company/): One subscription, a family of products, and a long-term relationship: the real change may be how small developers build a body of work.
- [The Big Opportunity for Internet Professionals Building One-Person Companies in the AI Era](https://wonderelian.com/en/notes/ai-era-opc-opportunity/) · [中文版](https://wonderelian.com/zh/notes/ai-era-opc-opportunity/): Connect product, design, development, and operations: begin with a real need of your own, then use apps, the web, and AI to bring a small product to a wider world.
- [AI Made Your Homepage Beautiful. Why Do People Still Not Understand It?](https://wonderelian.com/en/notes/ai-homepage-beautiful-but-unclear/) · [中文版](https://wonderelian.com/zh/notes/ai-homepage-beautiful-but-unclear/): A homepage can have character and still be clear: what is here, why it matters to the reader, and what happens after they click.
- [After AI Builds Your First Version, Why Does Every Change Leave You Less Sure?](https://wonderelian.com/en/notes/ai-first-product-what-to-fix-next/) · [中文版](https://wonderelian.com/zh/notes/ai-first-product-what-to-fix-next/): Your first version is here. How do you choose what to fix next? Make it work, make it clear, then refine it.
- [After a Serious Mistake, Can You Begin Again? Some Take Ten Years to Return Home; Others a Lifetime to Return to Themselves | The Odyssey](https://wonderelian.com/en/notes/odyssey-the-long-way-home/) · [中文版](https://wonderelian.com/zh/notes/odyssey-the-long-way-home/): Mistakes carry a price, and choices have consequences. What truly answers the past is the person you choose to become from this day forward.
- [Wendao 1.0 Is on the App Store: Reading the Tao Te Ching More Slowly—and More Closely](https://wonderelian.com/en/notes/wendao-1-0-app-store/) · [中文版](https://wonderelian.com/zh/notes/wendao-1-0-app-store/): An unhurried reading experience that brings source text, textual notes, translation, interpretation, and daily practice together.

## Citation guidance

When citing WonderElian, link to the canonical field-note or product URL above and attribute the work to Elian Yong. Product descriptions are factual summaries, not medical, scientific, spiritual, or income guarantees.
